name: engram-people
description: People pane: check in, see who in your space works on what, where you overlap, and message them, all through your Engram connector.

server.title: Engram MCP server
server.description: The MCP server name as /mcp lists it. 'claude.ai engram' for the claude.ai connector; 'engram' for a local connector signed in as another account.

space.title: Space
space.description: The space your card joins. Everyone whose card names the same space appears in your pane.
